This is the same cable car that me and family took for our joy ride and a look see from the Faber Peak, during our visit to S8ngapore in 2023.

In 1972, the government spent S$63,910 to renovate the bunkers and turn Mount Faber into a landscaped scenic spot, plus the construction of the S$2.94 million cable car system, just to link Mount Faber and Sentosa together.

The vegetation around Mount Faber is a secondary rainforest that is smaller and less dense than on Bukit Timah Hill.

Mount Faber is  separated from the adjacent slightly lower Telok Blangah Hill Park by Henderson Road.

Standing high above the sea levels, it offers panoramic views of the city skyline, the harbour, and Sentosa Island.

The site features dining options, event spaces, and the Bells of Happiness' area too.

To get to the Cable Car connection, just board from Harbour Front / Sentosa and alight directly at the Faber Peak station.
Or one can access it by car or taxi via Mount Faber Road.

Mount Faber Peak is one of Singapore’s most underrated destinations, combining stunning panoramic views, nature, dining and the iconic cable car experience all in one place

After making the climb through the lush greenery of Mount Faber Park, arriving at the peak feels like a reward in itself. The views are spectacular, stretching across the Southern Ridges, Sentosa, Keppel Harbour and the Singapore Strait. Watching the cable cars glide silently across the skyline adds a unique charm to the scenery and creates countless photo opportunities

We recently held our wedding lunch at Mount Faber Restaurant, and the entire experience was truly amazing from start to finish. The venue was beautiful, the food was excellent, and everything was very well organized.

A special thank you to the manager, who was incredibly attentive throughout the whole event. Their professionalism, responsiveness, and attention to detail made us feel very assured and taken care of during such an important day.

Our guests had a wonderful time, and we are very grateful to the whole team for making our wedding lunch such a memorable and smooth experience. Highly recommended for couples looking for a beautiful wedding venue with exceptional service!

Bugis street food market has evolved over the years and it is great to see the positive improvements in the layout, cleanliness and ventilation of the market.
Incorporating a mini food court in the midst of the stalls is ingenious! Affordable and easy to eat meals made easy.

One of the lousiest food court I had visited in my life!!!
So don't believe what you see on social media sometimes as these influencers are being paid to promote products be it good or bad as all they want is to make some quick cash.
The food prices are really high and portions are small. Only when you have no options only then I may consider coming back here again!!!

A perfect stop in the middle of shopping! The street food court is lively, full of flavors and offers so many tasty options at a reasonable price. A good spot to relax, grab a quick bite and recharge before continuing shopping 😁

Our family is incredibly grateful for the outstanding care my mother received during her hospitalization at Raffles Hospital. From the moment she was admitted until her discharge, every member of the medical team showed genuine compassion, professionalism, and dedication.
A special thank you to Dr. Andrew Fong Wei Liang, whose expertise, patience, and clear explanations gave our family great confidence throughout her treatment. He took the time to answer our questions, ensured my mother received the best possible care, and always treated her with kindness and respect.
We would also like to express our heartfelt appreciation to the nurses and the entire healthcare team. Their attentiveness, warmth, and tireless efforts made my mother's stay as comfortable as possible and provided reassurance to our family during a difficult time.
Thank you, Dr. Andrew Fong Wei Liang and the entire Raffles Hospital team, for your exceptional care and unwavering commitment to your patients. We highly recommend Raffles Hospital to anyone seeking high-quality medical care.

Raffles Hospital - Singapore

It’s a very nice and modern hospital.

I came here for a minor check up. When I entered the lobby, it was nice and clean. They have a friendly, Valet-Like person in white clothes that can help you navigate through this hospital.

I took the escalator to the second floor and waited in que, to sign up to be in que. About 30 minutes later when I was ready to put my information on the iPad, a friendly and helpful nurse let me know I was in wrong Que line. 🤭🙈

She assisted me to the right room. The Que line didn’t exist here. I signed up and set down in comfortable chairs to wait to see a doctor.

Overall good service and I would come back, should I have any future medical needs.

Had to visit Raffles Hospital recently. The facility is super modern and clean. Staff were professional, though the wait at A&E can be a bit long sometimes. It’s conveniently located near Bugis MRT, which is a plus. Overall, a reliable place for medical care in the city. Good experience!

The staff are friendly and food is great! We love the samyang pasta. It has the right balance of spicy and cream. The burger is also really good. Fast service too. Definitely coming back to this resto.

I had a wonderful experience at The Halal Corner Haji Lane. The food was absolutely delicious, and the service was excellent. A special thanks to Kak Era for making us feel so welcome and taken care of. The warm and friendly atmosphere really made the visit even more enjoyable. Highly recommended, and I will definitely come back again!
Overall a very satisfying experience, highly recommend!!!

Finally found a spot in Haji Lane that doesn't break the bank! The Halal Corner is such a vibe. Tried their carbonara beef steak and it was surprisingly good—super cheesy and the portion was huge. It’s a bit cozy/cramped inside, but that’s just the charm of this area. Great place to chill with friends after shopping. Will definitely be back for the loaded fries!

I came to try the burgers as ‘I do love the taste of a good burger’ 🍔

I had the cheeseburger and the butter burger and each burger is $16.50. The price is not a consideration for me as I’ve eaten burgers that cost much more.  It’s whether the burger is good.

To taste then, there are good aspects of it but I am not a fan of their special sauce and unfortunately that is the dominant taste. It’s a tangy more bbq style sauce and I don’t find it that great. Pickles are nice and has a sweet taste to them. Buns are soft and nice but will of course soak up a bit of that sauce. Patties are ok, not that moist or juicy though and maybe a bit more done than I would like and there’s the taste of that sauce.

Even the butter burger had that taste which may be in the relish with it.

For me it would be better if they had maybe another sauce option for people to decide what they would want. I saw that they have an ofc cheese sauce and maybe they should offer that as an alternative or something else.

Good service from the chap at the counter. Can get a bit noisy. But those are secondary considerations. Won’t be back for these burgers based on my taste 🍔

I truly believe One Fattened Calf Burgers serves the best burgers in Singapore. From the first bite, you can immediately taste the quality and passion behind every ingredient. The beef patty was juicy, tender, and packed with flavour, while the buns were soft, buttery, and perfectly toasted. Every component came together beautifully without feeling overly heavy or greasy.

What impressed me most was how thoughtfully crafted the burgers were. The sauces enhanced the flavours instead of overpowering them, and the toppings were fresh and balanced. The fries were also crispy, addictive, and the perfect side companion. Portions were generous and incredibly satisfying.

Beyond the food, I am honestly so proud that this is a local Singapore brand. It easily stands alongside some of the best international burger joints I have tried, yet still carries its own unique identity and character. Singapore truly has amazing homegrown talent, and One Fattened Calf Burgers is proof of that.

The staff were friendly and welcoming, creating a relaxed and enjoyable dining experience. Highly recommended for anyone looking for a truly memorable burger experience in Singapore.

Have been wanting to try this for quite a while le! Gotta say the glorious cheese fries was a bomb, burger was super delicious too! Good texture, overall well balanced taste, fresh ingredients. And most importantly the staff at cashier was super friendly and nice! (Boss pls give him a raise) was very attentive, observant and very helpful!

Really like the bun softness, and overall taste of the burger! Will be back!

Just drinks at $3.80 for bottled coke is slightly bit high!

Weekend evening time also quite crowded!

Passed by here for a transit. It was interconnected, with a nice walk to the respective MRT lines. Everything there is clean and polished. The toilet is immaculate too, with enough cubicles for a few.

The transiting is just a few minutes walk, which is a pretty good exercise. There's also a travelator to walk faster if you're in a rush. Overall, a tranquil environment for a hustling MRT station. Nice MRT station!

Its a lively street in the evenings. Singapore sleeps early so these streets also sleep off 😴.  Visit during Daytime and evenings eat the Bread Ice-cream and have a nice time . Some road side music too .

I love this new Brown Line Mrt, Orchard Boulevard, huge clean Area, really easy to get to Wheelock place, Shaw Center, Paterson through underground, few stops from Orchard to Marina Bay Sands, from Marina to Changi Airport only 1 stop amazing, really easy to travel to the Airport.

Had a wonderful Mother's Day dining experience at TSG restaurant! The service and hospitality were exceptional, especially from MOY, who was warm, attentive, and made us feel very welcomed throughout the meal. The food was absolutely delicious. The highlights for us were the lamb shoulder steak, beef bourguignon, potato gratin and chicken hot pie. Every dish was flavourful, well prepared, and truly satisfying. Thank you for making our Mother's Day celebration extra special. Highly recommend this place for both the amazing food and outstanding service. Will definitely come back again!

I honestly have no idea why this place has so many 4-5 star reviews. ive seen it all over TikTok, which is why i decided to give it a try with my partner.

We dined in for two and were seated outside. The ambience was actually pretty nice, no complaints there. But the food prices were honestly outrageous considering the quality of the food served.

We ordered:
- Steak Frites $38
- Pasta $26
- Potato Gratini $16 ? cant remember lol

and wow… the steak was genuinely bad. It tasted rubbery and definitely didn’t feel fresh, most likely frozen. I asked for medium but it came closer to well done. The pasta was extremely bland with almost no flavour at all.

We also ordered the potato gratin, but it literally tasted like mushroom soup poured over sliced potatoes. Again, very bland.

Overall, I’d rate the food 1/5. Total bill came up to about $108, and honestly, we left after only a few bites because we just couldn’t finish the food (as seen in the photos).

To be fair, the owner was actually very friendly and kind. He noticed we barely touched the food and came over to ask about it. He even offered us two pastries, then later offered kunafa and tea from his other shop, but we politely declined.

Fun fact: the owner isn’t Malay like many people think. Zeekri actually owns 3 restaurants around Arab Street some of which us turkish restaurant. Maybe French cuisine just isn’t his strong point.

Service and hospitality were good, but unfortunately the food was really not it for me. Still confused how this place has over 1.2k reviews with such high ratings. Personally, I don’t see myself coming back again.

Came in on a Saturday Morning and ordered Smoked Duck Aglio Olio, Striplion Steak Frites and the butter beer. Restaurant decor was really pleasing on the eyes. The pastry display was also mesmerising, I almost convinced the missus to grab the speculous cheesecake, alas we didn’t have the time. Food arrived timely. Both dishes were on point. Steak done perfectly medium rare.  Great job guys and thank you for the hospitality Moy!

An impressive and well-organised casino experience in the heart of Singapore. The atmosphere is vibrant yet elegant, with a wide variety of games and professional staff. Everything feels premium, from the design to the service. Definitely worth visiting if you’re in Marina Bay.

The interior looks fancy, and there are several options provided here and makes me fell into one conclusion, the best part of such a place like this is when you know when to stop unless you want to drain your pockets completely. However, they provide "all you can drink" options such as tea, coffee, mineral water, and milo FOR FREE.

There are two queue lines for entering this place, local and foreigners. For foreigners you need to provide your immigration details which has been submitted through myICA apps (once you filled in the questions, the copy of the information you submitted would be dispatched into your email as well), so you need to show it and your passport before entering this place

This is a truly grand and majestic casino right at the heart of Marina Bay, and you can feel that sense of scale and organisation the moment you step inside. It’s open 24 hours, which adds to the excitement, and entry for foreigners is free (locals pay a $100 entry fee), so it’s clearly designed to manage crowds while keeping things running smoothly. The place is massive, with an impressive range of games including roulette, sic bo, blackjack, baccarat, and a huge number of digital and physical tables and machines. There’s a noticeable emphasis on security, with cameras covering every inch of the floor, which gives the whole experience a very professional and transparent feel. The staff are excellent—polite, knowledgeable, and clearly confident in what they’re doing—and it shows in how efficiently everything operates. Free drinks are a nice touch, and members in particular are well looked after. Even if you’re just visiting to experience the atmosphere, it’s an impressive, well-run casino that feels polished without being intimidating.

Carnival Cinemas offers a good movie experience, especially if you're into Indian or regional films. The auditorium is quite spacious, which adds to the comfort during screenings. While the seating could use some upgrades for better comfort, it’s still a decent setup for the price you pay.

One of the highlights here is the affordability—not just the tickets, but the movie snacks too. It's one of the few places where you can still grab popcorn and drinks without feeling overcharged. The overall atmosphere is casual and welcoming, making it a good spot for a relaxed movie night.

A huge cinema hall for those interested  in watching Indian cinema.

The cinema hall itself is huge and clean with toilets for gents and ladies within the cinema hall.

Snacks are not expensive.  Both salted and sweet popcorn is available. Not to mention the decent samosas. Chilli sauce and tomato sauce for those interested are available in self serve press bottles.

Staff are attentive, polite and friendly.

Worst sound system. Worst experience.
Actually, I came all the way from Clementi because I had a good experience watching a previous movie in this theatre. But for the movie Karuppu, the sound experience was very, very poor.

Ate lunch here many times, the food is amazing we had the toothpick fish and their assorted croissants, coffee and the cream is out of this world, service from the servers and the managers are helpful and accommodating. Atmosphere is really nice and luxurious. Highly recommended , will definitely come here again. 🔥🔥👍🏻👍🏻

Visited Bacha Coffee on a Sunday afternoon. I’m handicapped and requested to be seated while my partner queued. We joined the queue at around 3pm and were seated 30-40 mins later, so be prepared to wait. The space is quite tight, a little challenging moving around.

We ordered the Tasmanian salmon ($35) and gnocchetti with crab meat and clams ($32). Both were well executed. The salmon was moist and flaky, with asparagus adding a nice crunch, though the potatoes were a little dry. The gnocchetti was flavourful and comforting, with sweet crab meat and briny clams, love the sauce that ties everything together. Bread and butter were also served, which was filling.

Overall, good food, but the wait took quite some time…

If you really want to taste a great variety of coffee this is the right place the flavors you can pick is more than you can imagine! Great coffee but be cautious how much you drink and how strong it is what you pick 😀 here the overdose of cafeine is the real deal. We had the Papua jewel and Peru around Lake Titikaka. The Peru one although having 2,5 on scale was extremly strong, however the taste was really great also the Papua was great much sweeter and less strong a bit more enjoyable 😊. Btw when the staff tell you one pot equals around two cups its way more and way higher chance of caffeine overodes 😅. The experience with reading through the history and sipping the coffee is truly enjoyable.

Wandered into this spot

We did ordered their hkm once before many years ago

Glad we walked into their cosy space. Late afternoon and super humid so their aircon was a lifesaver

Met with friendly smiles from their Burmese workers. The service here is superb.

And to beat it off Mr Ko, does FOH and whips up a superb plate of Hokkien mee!!! He was explaining to us about the dish when serving it. I’m touched that a foreign worker will bother to learn so much about one of our local dish. The sambal they serve with it is good. And the dish had all the traditional ingredients; sliced three layer pork aka pork belly, sotong, prawns, chives and boy their pork lard is damn crispy. No trace of rancid oil in every bits of it at all!

Pork satay serving was substantial not ur usual flat kind, this one is almost chunky. But wish they would’ve warm up the sauce figured it would’ve elevated the mango salsa that accompanied it

Ordered their ngor hiang to finish off our second bottle of wine. Tasty and convenient bite size but would’ve preferred it with pork instead of chicken 😝😂

Will definitely be back to try more of their dishes and the stout looks very tempting

Modern twist, you’re in luck. ✨ Fatt Choy Eating House at Haji Lane brings new life to traditionally delicious dishes, blending familiar local flavours with creative contemporary touches.

From the crispy Umami Shrimp Paste Chicken Karaage and rich Dry Aged Angus Beef Mapo Tofu, to the indulgent Roxy Crab Laksa topped with wild-caught crab and tobiko, every dish packs plenty of flavour. We also loved the Iberico Hainan Pork Satay, Xinjiang Lamb Skewer, Iberico Pork Ribs Bak Kut Teh, and their unique take on Singapore Fried Hokkien Mee wrapped in opeh leaf with scarlet prawn.

Save room for dessert — the Gula Melaka Tiramisu and Kaya Ice Cream with Churros are worth every calorie. 🍨

The prawn mee and pork belly are sooooo delicious. The menu offers a wide selection of signature Singaporean dishes, perfect for tourists who want to taste the local favourites.

Great services despite it doesn’t seem to have many staffs. Appreciated!

Song Fa delivers truly authentic flavors with a clean, comforting taste that keeps me coming back. I’ve been here at least five times, and every visit has been consistently great, that kind of reliability is rare and impressive.

You can really taste the quality of the ingredients. The meat is tender, clearly using good cuts.

I dropped by last minute during peak dining hours yesterday, and the team still managed to get me a table quickly!!!

Service was excellent overall, with a special mention to Heah, who was friendly, knowledgeable about the menu, and made the whole experience even more pleasant. It’s genuinely nice to see a place doing so well while maintaining such high standards.

Usually visit the VivoCity outlet but there's always a long queue. Came to the HarbourFront and was happy to be seated immediately. First time ordering their set meal 1 which consisted of pork tenderloin soup, rice, yu tiao, preserved vegetables and a sweet chilled drink. Yummy as expected but a little too much for a small eater.  Servers were very attentive offering soup to-up without being asked and polite. No charge for the packet of wet wipe they kindly provided. Will switch to visiting to this outlet instead of VivoCity.

My family and my fav Song Fa Bak Kut Teh store. Spacious layout and friendly staffs, especially Sis Irene. Irene is always smiling and will say “好久不见！ 你们来了！” always feel like home when she said that.

Food is great and we always order our fav dishes and soup.

Services is great as well with their soup top up quickly.

We will miss this store, the staffs, the food and their service.

Marina Bay Sands is truly an iconic landmark in Singapore and always delivers a world-class experience. The architecture is stunning, especially at night when the skyline lights up beautifully — it’s one of the most recognizable views in the city.

The SkyPark observation deck offers breathtaking panoramic views, and the infinity pool (for hotel guests) is simply unforgettable. The entire property feels luxurious, spacious, and very well maintained.

Dining at Marina Bay Sands is also a highlight. There is an impressive range of restaurants — from celebrity chef concepts to refined Asian and international cuisine. Whether you are looking for fine dining with a spectacular rooftop view or casual dining options, the quality and ambience are consistently excellent. It’s a great place for business meals, celebrations, or romantic dinners.

The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands provide a premium shopping experience with a wide selection of luxury brands, and service throughout the property is generally professional and attentive.

Overall, Marina Bay Sands is a must-visit destination in Singapore — perfect for a staycation, dining experience, or simply enjoying the incredible city skyline.

One of the best if not top 3 malls I have visited across the world. A lot of different shops and a very large scale shopping mall. Has its own play area and food court with multiple options. A lot of foot traffic at this mall. You can ride a boat as well. They have all sorts of stores to shop at for everyone. Definately worth visiting.

Absolutely love The Shoppes at Marina Bay Sands. The entire mall feels premium the moment you step in. The mix of luxury boutiques, flagship stores and unique dining options makes it one of the best places to shop and explore in Singapore. The walkways are spacious, the architecture is beautiful and everything is always clean and well-maintained. Service from the staff across the shops has consistently been warm and professional. Whether you’re here for shopping, a nice meal or simply enjoying the ambiance, it never disappoints. Definitely a must-visit.

I had the sweetest day out with my grandma at Yue Hwa. The moment we walked in, she was so excited, it was a huge store selling things from traditional Chinese medicine to snacks and clothing all in one place.
We first stopped by the chinese restaurant located at the top of the rooftop to have our lunch. When the tummy is filled we proceed with out shopping at the clothing section to choose out a gorgeous outfit for her to wear at my cousion wedding.
It was a simple outing, but it reminded me how precious these small moments are. I’ll always treasure that day with her.

I recently made a purchase through Yue Hwa’s online retail store, and I couldn't be happier with the experience. A huge, special thank you goes out to Jane Lee, who went absolutely above and beyond to assist me with my order.

Not only was she incredibly helpful throughout the process, but she also went completely out of her way to facilitate and smooth out the pickup of my goods. It’s rare to find this level of dedicated customer care these days. Fantastic service from Yue Hwa, and stellar support from Jane! I will definitely be shopping here again.

It was such a pleasant and smooth shopping experience in Yue Hwa with the help of a trainee staff named Ah Xiang. We were unable to find the item we wanted but Ah Siang was so helpful that he came to help. He not only found what we wanted, his product knowledge is wonderful even though he is only a trainee. With his recommendations, instead of only buying one item which was our original plan, we ended up purchasing a few items in the store. We also saw Ah Siang is so sincere and helpful towards other customers who needed help.

We stayed nearby the Tanjong Pagar MRT station and it’s so convenient to go there the Changi airport from here. Just take the Pasir Ris line from Tanjong Pagar to Tanah Merah. From Tanah Merah you board another direct to Changi Airport which is the end stop. The experience was good and not too crowded. Everything was seamlessly connected.

I love how this MRT Station "opens" up at the basement level of the "very happening" Guoco Tower in the Central Business District. I also love how well connected this MRT Station is to the nearby Tanjong Pagar Plaza area where there is an abundance of very good and reasonably priced food at the hawker centre and eateries thereat. And to mention as well, a couple of nice hotels in the nearby vicinity.

Mansion7 is one of the best Chinese dining experiences I’ve had in Singapore—memorable food, exceptional value, and truly outstanding service.

Every dish was thoughtfully curated to suit our tastes, thanks to Alex, the restaurant manager, who has an incredible ability to understand his guests and recommend dishes we instantly fell in love with.

The abalone with crispy edges coated in salted egg yolk was a revelation—crispy and chewy at the same time. The prawns in mango sauce were bright, appetising, and beautifully balanced. The pork chop, served with tomato sauce and wine, was unbelievably tender. The Beijing Duck was a visual masterpiece, presented on a picturesque plate and expertly wrapped for us—no awkward DIY wrapping, just pure enjoyment. The shark’s fin soup was so flavourful! It had a generous portion of ingredients like mushrooms, fish maw and thick crab meat!

The finale was unforgettable: a durian puff with sesame crystal skin and Mao Shan Wang filling, dramatically revealed with dry ice. A true visual and sensory delight.

What truly touched me, beyond the food, was the service. Alex stayed attentive throughout the evening, respectfully giving us space during deep and meaningful conversations, and even stayed beyond closing time to ensure we were comfortable and happy.

This is white-glove service at its finest in the F&B industry. Mansion7 delivers not just a meal, but a complete, thoughtful dining experience. Highly recommended.

My poor Queen has eczema and I came along for her appointment. We first went to 7A for public consultation and requested to receive private services so when we went to 6A, the drastic change in environment was shocking. Just 1 floor apart, the clientele had a 180 change

RUN if your assigned Dr is Goh Chee Leok. Uncle should just retire instead of wasting everyone's time and money. Read the rest of the reviews here for more details.

If you are experiencing long waiting time, pls go see if Dr Goh is around. If yes, probably taking his own sweet time to slack in between patients.

Treatments are efficient overall.
But phone customer service is non-existent.
Tried to call to reschedule appointment on 3 separate occasions and after a 15 min wait each time. (Tried on different times during working hours) apparently due to  all agents being super busy assisting others, the call ended with a callback option, where I provided my number.

Two of those callback never arrived and one did after almost a week of the original call and that too was a missed call! Ridiculous!

**Marina Bay Waterfront Promenade** ✨🌃

A beautiful place to slow down and soak in Singapore's skyline. The sparkling city lights, waterfront breeze, and stunning views make every walk feel magical—especially after sunset. One of the best spots for photos and peaceful evening vibes.

Omg such a really nice place to visit. Its classy. The building ng has all the luxury stores from a to z worth millions of dollars. Very neatly maintained. Great tourist spot. Highly recommended place for everyone.

I’ve been there many times and I still never get bored. I love the vibe, whenever I visit Singapore, I know I’ll be walking a lot

It’s quite similar to Jakarta in terms of public transport, everything connects to tourist attractions and busy areas, but Singapore is way more organized

People and vehicles are very disciplined, there’s traffic sometimes, but not as chaotic as Jakarta LOL

Honestly, I’ll probably never get tired of going to Singapore...

We had a very comfortable experience at Yì this afternoon, celebrating my mum’s birthday. The staff were all really friendly and kind, they explained to us the food served and were all attentive. Since it was a special occasion, they kindly asked if we would like photos taken even without us asking. Longevity buns were complimentary and a nice surprise. I love the space, it was cozy and spaced out (not too close to the next table). The textile, ceramics and lighting were really elegant. The food was refreshing and on the lighter side. Overall a lovely experience!

An amazing lunch we had here. Food is of good quality and value. Atmosphere wise really depends on the fellow diners. It’s rather noisy today due to bigger groups in the main dining hall.

The service is exceptionally great and we love how Jess shared with us about the dishes and engaged us in the dining experience. She’s lovely and made our time here very pleasant.

Attaching some of the dish photos here. We had the set lunch. Almost all items were great. Just the main dish which is the Black Cod was rather too salty (when eaten alone) BUUUTTT the chef coupled that dish with the plainer tasting egg white (that has nice bubble bites) and tangy sour side garnish, that actually made it a well balanced dish still.

Overall we love the place and will definitely visit again. Next time maybe we will try out their dim sum variety.

My family had a wonderful experience dining at Yì. We were warmly greeted by the hosts and led through a beautifully curated walkway. The ambiance, environment and decor were immaculate. The staff were friendly, attentive and had a very positive attitude (I'll gladly pay service charge here). We decided to get 2 set meals and add on some ala carte dishes -- everything was a hit. The dishes were presented beautifully and we were pleasantly surprised by how every dish did not disappoint.

Big shoutout to Mei Ling for her service (we literally never saw the bottom of our tea cup). It was our first time dining at Yì and she helped to make the experience memorable from answering questions about the dishes, to the timing of service for each dish, to checking in on us throughout the meal to ensure the food is good, to organizing a little treat for celebrating my dad's birthday. We truly appreciate it and couldn't have asked for a better experience!

I'd recommend this place to others and would probably come back again ✨ (photos don't do this place justice bc we were too busy eating and enjoying ourselves that I just quickly snapped random shots to document what I ate).
Super cosy place to hang out with friends over sake. Friendly service team serves delicious skewers and snacks but the chawanmushi was really good. Good vibes. Shiok.

I visited this bar for drinks after dining at No Signboard, as it is located right nearby. I returned here after a long time since my last visit in 2018.

While the vibe and interior are still the same as I remembered, the overall experience was a bit disappointing.

My favourite salad had been removed from the menu, and the draft beer was also a letdown.

It wasn’t a huge disappointment (so much), but compared to my good memories from years ago, it didn't quite meet my expectations.
1st time visiting this lovely place. Some interesting items such as bacon wrapped lychee, grilled avocado and taopok. You can choose air con or outdoor dining.

Delicious food, brunch options are different from the usual offerings at other cafes in a good way. Portion sizes are ok. Pricing is slightly above average but not excessive. Nice hip ambiance. Service is average. We really enjoyed the food here and will return to try more dishes!
Stock pot chicken was good, flavorful, mushrooms were tasty and it was hearty. Beef in the beef Don was really well executed. Grilled cheese was awesome, super stringy cheese and not excessively mature / strong. Banana bread could have been tastier - but the marscapone topping was pretty and tasty. Filter coffee tasted good but presentation could be better.
Overall, strongly recommend!

loved the interior of this cafe, the ambience is great. staffs are helpful

food was alright, i had the scallop rose mafaldine and truffle fries. the scallops were nicely seared and flavourful but the flavour of the pasta noodles felt flat. the truffle fries didn’t really have a truffle taste, instead more of a cheese taste (get something else for your appetiser/sides instead!) some other items on the menu looked interesting tho!

Pet friendly Al Fresco Dining joint.
Aircon option available indoors (without pets).

The environment was cosy, spacious and not too hot (evening time). Food/Dessert was average tasting given the relatively high price point.

Quiet for a Saturday evening, no reservations required. Probably more suited for a cafe stop by (for coffee/tea) rather than dinner.
Malls and five-star hotels. There’s the Michelin-row of restaurants. Chinatown SG is the best area to stay. Clean and not crowded.

I love Chinatown Food Street.
Now, all the food stalls were removed.
There were many famous food stall, fried char keow teow, chendol, satay etc
Yummy! Yummy! Yummy!

Very centralized. Food plentiful, hdb public housing nearby facing City skyline offices. Good mix of shops food merchandise massage parlors at People's park complex. MRT a walking distance to rest of the stations islandwide.

Loving the welcoming neighbourhood bistro vibes right at the corner! Loving the friendly staffs too! Love their cute T-shirt too! They have happy hour for their drinks 🍻🍻 great for a good catch up after a long day at work! ❤️

🦐PRAWN LINGUINE - Kind of a fusion dish in a claypot with prawn infused home-made broth! Hot sizzling!
🍕Four Cheese Pizza - Mozzarella, Parmesan,
Camembert & Burrata served with Maple Syrup, definitely satisfying!
🍟TRUFFLE FRIES - Straight Cut with Grated Parmesan and real truffle carpaccio served with Truffle Mayo, great for sharing and matching with 🍺
🍻Birds of Paradise WHITE IPA 5.5% PINT - friends enjoyed the beer!

Great spot to hang out with friends. It’s dog-friendly too, so you’ll get to see plenty of cute furry companions around. The service was quick and friendly, and the beer was especially enjoyable during happy hour at a great price. The food was decent as well. Would definitely come back!

The food was excellent, especially the truffle pizza, which we truly enjoyed. Unfortunately, the service did not match the quality of the food. One of the staff members was quite rude and came across as discriminatory in the way we were addressed.

While I acknowledge that we may have made a mistake, there are more respectful and professional ways to communicate with customers. Being pointed at and spoken to in a harsh manner was unnecessary and disappointing.

This was one of the worst service experiences I’ve had in Singapore. I also noticed similar feedback from other reviewers, so I sincerely hope management takes these concerns seriously and works on improving customer service.

Came here for a gathering on my first visit. My friends ordered the truffle fries, but they were disappointed because they weren't as good as they remembered. The fries were dry and seemed overcooked.

Aina, our server, promptly took the dish back to the kitchen. Shortly after, Kingz came over with the same plate to understand what the issue was. He handled our feedback professionally and returned with a freshly prepared plate of perfectly cooked truffle fries, much to our delight.

Kudos to Aina and Kingz for their excellent service recovery. Their attentiveness and professionalism turned a disappointing experience into a positive one.

Cheers !
Jul 14 2026

We came here 3 times during our stay in Singapore. We really liked this Café because the food is great and the coffee is amazing! Best Mocha I‘ve ever had. Very talented baristas. The only reason I cannot give 5 stars is that unfortunately every time we ate there, the food of me and my partner came with quite some delay to each other, so that one person needed to wait 5-15min while the other person was already having their meal.
Makes it difficult to have breakfast „together“. Apart from that, great Café.

Visited Five Oars Coffee Roasters after seeing favorable reviews.
The items we tried were decent and satisfying, and the iced white coffee stood out — smooth, well-balanced and refreshing.
The interior seating is quite compact, so it can get a little noisy during peak hours.

Thankfully, there’s plenty of outdoor seating available if you prefer a more relaxed setting.
Overall, a solid spot for coffee and casual brunch in the Tanjong Pagar area.

Little India is a vibrant and lively place, perfect for shopping and experiencing Indian culture in Singapore. Mustafa Centre is one of the biggest and most famous shopping malls here, where you can find almost everything at reasonable prices. There are many Indian restaurants and shops, and you will see a large Tamil community in this area.
There are beautiful North Indian and South Indian temples, giving the place a very spiritual and traditional feel. All kinds of Indian groceries, vegetables, spices, clothes, and accessories are easily available. While roaming around, you will find many people from India, which makes the place feel like home.
Overall, Little India is a must-visit for shopping, food, and cultural experience in Singapore.

Little India MRT Station - this MRT Station between Newton MRT Station and Rochor MRT Station on the Downtown Line, is also the interchange for the North East Line. It is a very busy MRT Station as it is located in (where else, but the very bustling) the wider Little India area and the smaller Tekka Centre area within the former, which are highly popular with locals, tourists and, on weekends in particular, migrant workers on their day or days off.  And both aforementioned areas are great places for shopping and dining.

Little India MRT Station (NE7) is a busy but well-organised interchange between the Downtown Line and North East Line. The station is clean, brightly lit, and has clear signage that makes transfers easy. It’s located right in the heart of Little India, so access to food, shops, and cultural spots is very convenient. It does get crowded during peak hours and festive seasons, but overall it’s a reliable and lively station with great connectivity.

Rumifolks is one of the more chill and aesthetic café spots around the Haji Lane / Bali Lane area in Singapore, especially if you enjoy cozy café vibes, creative coffee drinks, and a relaxing place to lepak with friends or do some light work. The café was previously known as “Rumi The Poet’s Cup” before reopening nearby with a refreshed concept and brighter interior.

The atmosphere is probably the biggest attraction here — warm lighting, bookshelves, plants, artsy decorations, and a calm ambience that feels very fitting with the Haji Lane culture. Many visitors mention the friendly staff and comfortable environment for long conversations or just enjoying coffee slowly.

For drinks, their signature items like the Pandan Latte, Butterscotch Americano, Strawberry Matcha, and Salted Caramel Macchiato are among the popular choices. The coffee menu is more unique compared to many standard cafés nearby, especially if you like sweeter or flavoured specialty-style drinks.

Food-wise, the menu is more café-style comfort food rather than heavy meals. Croissant sandwiches, waffles, fries, cakes, and desserts are commonly recommended. Portion sizes are decent, though some reviewers feel the pricing is slightly on the premium café side.

Overall, Rumifolks is more about the full café experience — ambience, aesthetics, relaxing environment, and creative drinks — rather than purely hardcore specialty coffee. It’s a nice stop if you’re exploring Haji Lane or Kampong Glam and want a comfortable halal-friendly café to unwind. Suitable for couples, café hopping, casual meetings, or coffee hunting with friends.

Really enjoyed my time here! The ambience was great, the seating was cosy, and the overall vibes were immaculate. Loved the playlist too, the song choices were amazing and made the place feel even more welcoming.

Had the Rumichino and it was nice! Personally, I would’ve preferred it a little less sweet, but that’s just my taste.

Also, shoutout to the staff for being so friendly and warm throughout. Had a lovely experience and would definitely visit again! :)

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐

As a Singaporean, I absolutely love the vibe at Rumifolks on Bali Lane. It's one of those rare places where you can truly slow down, relax, and enjoy the moment. Unlike many cafés in Singapore that can feel rushed or crowded, this place has such a calm, welcoming atmosphere.

The food and snacks are delicious, and every dish I ordered exceeded my expectations. The coffee is excellent too—great quality and very reasonably priced. Service was warm, attentive, and genuinely friendly, which made the experience even better.

The music is thoughtfully selected—not too loud, just enough to create a relaxing ambience that's perfect for conversations, reading, or simply unwinding. It's easy to see why this place is so popular.

What makes Rumifolks truly special is its genuine commitment to arts, poetry, culture, and the creative community. It's inspiring to see a café that not only serves great food and coffee but also creates opportunities for cultural exchange, artistic expression, and live performances. Spaces like this are becoming increasingly rare, and I really admire their vision of bringing people together through creativity and meaningful experiences.

Whether you're an artist, performer, poet, musician, or simply someone looking for a peaceful place to relax and be inspired, Rumifolks is a place worth visiting.

I highly recommend Rumifolks to anyone looking for great food, excellent coffee, wonderful service, and a unique space where culture, arts, and community come together. I'll definitely be coming back whenever I'm in the area!

Nice food and service especially Ming. He is attentive, friendly and great in recommendation. We came here twice in a week and made reservation via call. He has handle everything well and made it a pleasant visit. Food is good, excellent ice cream and cake and I love the hojicha.
Food tasted so fresh, homely and thoughtful. Service was great and friendly. There wasn’t one dish which I didn’t like. Would come back to try all their dishes!

Lovely atmosphere and very cozy environment. The staff were all very kind and friendly, which made the experience even better. The food was great and the cake was absolutely delicious — definitely one of the highlights! Would love to come back again 😊

Mt Elizabeth is Great Again

After the effort to renovate the hospital, this place seems to have given itself a new lease of life.

It now has a beautiful lobby, business centre, and everything basically looks new again.

The short stay I had here gave me a very good impression. Service from the nurses in the wards, to all other staff involved in my admission were polite, friendly and helpful. The magic is always in the people.

The room was nicely renovated and had almost all the amenities one can think of. The food served was top notch and sufficient.

The checkout service was fast and efficient. I didn’t even have to go to the business office to settle the bill there in person. And they make transport arrangements to send you to your home or hotel.

Overall a very pleasant experience.

Overall, I had

Mount Elizabeth Hospital sets a genuinely high bar for patient care — from the moment of admission, the warmth and professionalism of the staff made a stressful experience feel manageable. Every interaction carried a quiet reassurance that you were in good hands, with the team taking time to explain, check in, and make you feel genuinely looked after rather than just processed through.

The level of hospitality here goes well beyond what you’d expect from a hospital — attentive, compassionate, and consistently professional throughout. Hard to feel grateful for a hospital stay, but the people here make it easy. ❤️

My wife was warded here after a brain op. I lodged together with her for about 5 days. Unlike the lackluster reviews of others here, we experienced the best of everything, from customer service, admin, ward nurses, porters, housekeeping, and food services. Everything was top notch service. Smiles all around, sometimes we forget this is a hospital, felt like a 6-star hotel service.  Room and facilities work as advertised and intended. Honestly the human factor just covers any hardware flaws you might encounter. I left the best part to the last. The food menu, OMG., opulence, exquisite, heavenly, MasterChef quality. I know everyone's only talking about the lobster laksa. Yes that's good too. But I must specifically point out the beef rendang. I have always like beef rendang but Mt E's rendition is the best by far. I have never tasted a beef rendang more tender and juicy than theirs. My saddest fleeting thought was that I will never get to eat this again unless I am hospitalized. Touch wood. As they say, there are some things worth dying for.... Mt E's beef rendang comes really close.

Was here for a 933 celebration event. Accessible, good song selection. Good sound in the room. Good service. We were able to eat dinner with drinks while singing. Affordable prices! Teo Heng is always a trustable brand, family friendly, wallet friendly, enjoyable!
Very nice and clean place! Sound system is awesome, as expected of every Teo Heng branch. Thank you to the staff who make it really fast to clean out the room for our sessions! :)

Great spot for karaoke! The mall isn’t crowded at night since it’s not in a residential area. Service was good, and the equipment is well-maintained. Pricing is also reasonable since it’s based on the room, not per person. The small, air-conditioned room I used had 2 mics and could comfortably fit up to 4 people.

Looks like they have a snacks area (you need to pay for it if you want) near the counter. This karaoke spot is also family-friendly. Will definitely patronize their outlets again!

A vibey cocktail bar that turns into a club at 11pm. We went in around 9pm and the vibes were already amazing - loved it.
They have a wide variety of drinks with creative Korean-inspired twists (think kimchi, ginseng, Seoul vibes, etc).

Mandarin Whisky Sour ($26)
Raspberry ($26)
Ginseng Pear ($26)

Once it turned into a club, we stayed for a bit. The space got pretty cramped since it's small, but the songs were good and apparently there was a well-known DJ that night.

Baes Club is awesome. Great hiphop music, DJ's are good, staff is customer oriented, food is good, overall great. The space might be compact as it was at Tanjong Pagar district but was very well managed by the Head of security, Mr Aby. Security managemenr, Crowd Control, De-escalation of issues, adapting with the customers regardless of age or status always giving respects to all. Compared to few clubs where the bouncers were aggressive, at Baes the Bouncers under the guidance of Mr Aby are disciplined and customer oriented. A True leader to all. I heard well of Mr Aby where he took good care of his Clients, friends and colleagues. A man of Discipline and Dignity. Always great to see Mr Aby managing a place. Known in google amd social media as Aby Al-Sofli. Looking forward to meet him again. Baes is the best in town

First time at Bae’s with my bestie and it was such a lovely experience. We got the Soju Basil Smash and Kosho Berry which were really yummy.  Staffs were so friendly - especially Ruth - who went above and beyond in providing thoughtful recommendations and being such a rockstar. We will be back for sure. see you again Ruth!

Delicious indo food. The rice wrapped in banana leaf was fragrant and the grilled ayam bakar was tender and tasty. The chilli served on the side is fierily spicy. Soto betawi beef soup I sampled from my colleague's bowl was very comforting and would love to order it another day.

The food was delicious. The sate lilit chicken was well marinated. Sambal was good with the rice
Gado-gado gravy was nice and not watery. Amazingly the gado gado was without rice cake so it's healthier. Even though without rice cake (ketupat) the serving is quite filling
Will definitely come again to try different food on the menu

Ordered the grilled chicken set. The rice was nice, tasting similar to butter rice or chicken rice, and was very fragrant.

Personally, I found the drinks to be just so-so. They were on the sweeter side and felt a bit too syrupy for my liking.

I recently stayed at Mount Elizabeth Novena Hospital for 5 days last week in Ward 11, and I would like to express my sincere appreciation to the nursing team there.

All of the nurses were incredibly attentive, professional, and caring throughout my stay. Recovering from surgery was not easy, and although I did not have much appetite after the operation, I was pleasantly surprised by the wide variety of food choices available from light and simple meals to dishes that felt like hotel quality cuisine.

Unfortunately, I cannot remember every nurse’s name, but the kindness and compassion they showed left a very deep impression on me. However, there is one nurse I especially want to mention and thank — Gaite Michelle Anglea. Her attentiveness, warmth, and genuine care made me feel safe and reassured during a difficult time as a patient.

Thank you to Ward 11 and the entire team for the excellent care and support.

Here’s a clearer and more concise version:

> I was warded here for 3.5 days and did not regret my choice. The room was spacious and clean, fully stocked with toiletries, and housekeeping was done daily (including changing the bedsheets). The nurses were very polite, proactive, and helpful — I did not encounter anyone who was unfriendly or unapproachable. In fact, they consistently reminded me to call if I needed anything or assistance getting out of bed. The food variety was excellent, and some dishes were really delicious.

My only feedback is a small point: I hope the drinking cup can be changed daily when new flasks of water are provided.

Highly recommended!

My 2 days 1 night stay was comfortable and seamless - from registration to preparation for surgery and after-sugery care. Room was spacious, food was good, most of all the nurses and staff of ward 7 were all professional and caring. Nurse Mabella Chan's standard of care and service was nothing short of excellent and upheld Mount Elizabeth Novena reputation as one of the premier medical institution.

It felt like home. I checked, no bedbugs! Also no roaches. Bed is very comfy, ac is cold, water in shower is hot. I paid about 60SGD per night and it was the cheapest hotel room around so naturally I did not know what to expect. My surroundings felt very modern and comfortable. Plus the best location. Literally no complaints. They also allowed me to put $100 usd as a deposit, making it easier to check in and deal with local atm at a later time. Compared to single bed hotels I stayed in the past, especially in Hong Kong and Tokyo, this room felt spacious.

The room is small, but clean enough to sleep. The toilet and shower in one small room, and there is bidet 😭 this is one of the important
thing for Indonesian people hehehe.
There is free water drink for us in the room
near lobby and small space for sitting down.
We need to deposit SGD 100 for stay here, i think you need to prepare cash or credit card fot this, I prefer cash.
With the price and the quality of the room, I think its fair enough, dont expect too much.

If you need breakfast you can walk to Maxwell Hawker Center, its quiet near from the hotel, and there is 7 eleven just for 1 min walk.

Got here on super discount so was nervous if it was too gpod to be true. Its perfectly fine for solo traveller. Here's a list:

Pros: pricing, locoation, has bidet, nice staff, bathroom space
Cons: the s room bed is very short (not recomm for 5'8 ft+) , mobile network gets blocked bc of thick walls and no window room so need to depend solely on hotel wifi (the security config looks weak so dont login to bank apps or any acc inside hotel)

Busy but reliable interchange serving both North-South line and East-West line, as well as walking distance to the Circle line. City Hall MRT Station has been a Singapore icon for decades including for myself since I was a kid. Today we brought our 2-year-old kid here to get his first concession card since he’s above 90cm but younger than 7-years-old, really helpful staff at the SimplyGo counter that made the process so swift and efficient. Will be back again soon for sure! Walking distance to malls like Raffles City Shopping Centre and Marina Square, as well as Singapore Management University.

Big and clean station. Raffle city and Marina Square nearby, thus, good places for shopping and hanging around. Also can walk to Merlion and Garden by the Bay.
Can use bankcard for train tickets which is very convenient.

Extremely convenient MRT station here in the middle of town! It's pretty much a no brainer interchange, connecting the green and the red lines. It's probably also the MRT station for any national held events if you're attending them. F1, National Day, etc.

I really love the Pilates here and have been coming here consistently multiple times a week! Contrary to some other reviews I’ve actually found the front of house quite friendly, they always say bye to me when I leave the studio and greet me warmly.

I like this outlet much more than the Maxwell one because the lighting in the reformer studio is warmer and there’s less reformers per room. The rooms are also a lot more aesthetic haha

I also really love the breakfast club smoothie, it’s the best smoothie I’ve ever had in my life 🤣

Unfortunately, due to traffic and the building entrance being under maintenance, I had difficulty locating the correct entrance and had to find the back entrance to access the studio. After I explained the situation and asked whether I would still be charged a no-show fee despite already arriving at the studio, the female staff member responded coldly and without any empathy: “Yes, you will be charged no-show fees.”

Throughout the interaction, her tone was dismissive, impatient, and unnecessarily rude. There was absolutely no attempt to communicate professionally or show even basic customer courtesy. I understand policies may exist, but there is a major difference between enforcing a policy and treating customers with complete disregard.

I would like this complaint regarding the staff member’s conduct to be taken seriously. Unfortunately, I did not get her name, but she was the female front desk staff assisting customers on May 9 between approximately 1:50–1:55 PM.

Overall, this was an extremely unpleasant customer experience:

I lost both my ClassPass credits and transportation costs despite physically arriving at the studio.
I was denied entry over a two-minute delay caused partly by the building maintenance situation.
Most importantly, I was treated with a shocking lack of professionalism and empathy by your staff.
I would appreciate hearing about the outcome or follow-up actions taken regarding this complaint, as I believe this level of customer service is unacceptable and should be properly addressed.

First time experiencing Pilates, and I can say I thoroughly enjoyed it. I went for the Reformer Essentials class, which I found challenging but really fun.

A big part of my great experience was thanks to the instructor, Aretha A. She was fun, professional, and extremely helpful whenever I was doing a movement incorrectly. She is very knowledgeable about anatomy, and you can really tell she loves teaching. Definitely look for her for your next class! 👍🏻👍🏻

It’s new, super clean, and the beds are really comfy. I’m happy I chose a room without a window because the street is noisy with construction and restaurants.

The soundproofing between rooms is okay, but not to the hallway. People stop walking in the hallway around midnight, and the nights were very quiet until late morning.

Reception isn’t open 24/7, so you might need to check in yourself through the app, but the instructions are clear and your room key is also in the app.

The showers and toilets were very clean, and the AC worked perfectly.

I really liked it, and the location is 10/10. Definitely recommend it for budget travel 💯

Me and my wife was greeted warmly upon arriving to the hotel by Rui & Fara (?)  Check in was very convenient and it is through an application and to unlock the room door is via your phone.

Room was super cozy & clean too. We had a great stay here and would definitely come back.

Upon check out, Markus (?) assisted with the check out. Man was very friendly too.

Overall, all the staff were welcoming & friendly. Room is clean and very cozy. Would definitely come back here again with my wife.

Nice room, TV with netflix is working fine. Daily change towel. Morning can have a coffee at the cooklab. Very near to Maxwell market with a lot famous food, China Town market with affordable cheap and delicious dishes. Walk a bit more, there is Amoy and Tanjung Pagar food center. Beside local food, there is a lot Korean restaurant nearby, one 24hr Korean restaurant at opposite. Nearby walkable distance MRT to Green, Brown line.

Great atmosphere and service. Love the Thai roasted pork belly with the Thai spicy chili. 🌶️🤭 (best roasted pork belly no cap). With the weekend $30 set meal—consists of a lot of choices come with an alcoholic drink. Me and my friend ordered the pork chop while I ordered the fish and chips. 😋 The fish and chips is delicious. They season their fish very well. Definitely recommend the tomyum soup. Very authentic. Definitely loving the experience. After my dinner, I sat by the window seat and enjoyed the magnificent view.

We spent our night at Moon Rooftop Bar & Lounge and the vibes were so good for a chill weekend date night. We literally got to sip, dine, and unwind under the moon and stars 🌙✨ so dreamy and pretty!

Their Weekend Dinner Set is only $30 nett and comes with a main + drink pairing 🍽️🍷 honestly such a good deal for rooftop dining. The service was excellent too, special shout out to Jawa & Suly, which made the whole experience even more enjoyable 🫶 Jawa even serve us cold water, when we were shooting out the restaurant under super hot weather. So caring🥰

the food is perfect and the view is certainly instagram worthy. i am usually not a fan of thai flavoured sauce but surprisingly it fits the dish well. Will definitely recommend tis to my frends and come back again :)
Great food. Enjoyed a fresh, tasty meal here this evening. Onion bhaji, samosa, chicken tikka, chicken vindaloo, garlic naan bread. Would definitely recommend

Got the Butter Chicken, garlic naan, mango lassi. I think it was around 39$ after all charges.

Taste wise, it was amazing. I could taste the grill in the chicken gravy, very garlicky, the naan had fresh garlic over it and it was very good, chicken was extremely tender and flavourful.

However! The prices are portions are insane! It's tiny! For $22 for a small bowl, maybe 7 pieces of chicken. 1 naan for 4-6$. I thought that I couldn't finish it when I saw the price, thought it was to share with multiple people, but consider me "relieved" when I saw it come out. The saving grace is the taste, because the price lowered my enjoyment.

Open house. SMU is situated in central part of Singapore, mainly around Bras Basah-City Hall district. A reputable university offering undergraduate studies in Law, Economics,Accountancy,Business, Computer Science, post graduate and doctoral courses. Well connected to nearby mrt and public transportation networks, easily accessible to students traveling by public transport. SMU consists of 10 buildings with 6 buildings are schools/academic, 4 buildings are campus / student facilities, spread across the campus city area.

⭐⭐⭐⭐⭐ Excellent learning experience with strong industry relevance

SMU Academy provides a well-structured and professionally run learning environment. From onboarding to programme briefings, everything has been smooth, organised, and clearly designed for working professionals.

What impressed me most is how industry-relevant the content is. The modules are practical, up-to-date, and focused on real application instead of just theory. The facilitators are experienced practitioners who encourage discussion, critical thinking, and sharing of perspectives — making each session engaging and meaningful.

Administrative support has been responsive, and the networking opportunities are a big bonus, bringing together participants from different industries to exchange ideas.

Overall, SMU Academy delivers a high-quality learning experience that truly adds value for mid-career professionals and business leaders looking to upskill and stay ahead. Highly recommended.

Singapore Management University (SMU) is a top-notch institution that's making waves in Asia! Established in 2000, it's a public university located in the heart of Singapore, offering a wide range of undergraduate and postgraduate programs.

*Key Highlights:*

- *Rankings*: SMU is ranked #3 in Singapore and #1016 globally, with top rankings in fields like Investment Banking, Real Estate, and Accounting.
- *Research*: The university is known for its high-impact research, with faculty members collaborating with international researchers and partners in the business community.
- *Campus*: SMU's city campus is modern and well-equipped, providing students with a vibrant learning environment.
- *Programs*: SMU offers bachelors, masters, and PhD programs in various fields, including Business, Economics, Law, and Computing.¹ ²
*Student Life:*
- *Student Body*: Over 12,000 students from diverse backgrounds.
- *Facilities*: State-of-the-art library, sports facilities, and administrative services.
*Admissions:*
- *Tuition Fees*: SGD 11,500 for local students and SGD 24,600 for international students.
- *Scholarships*: Available for deserving students.
Overall, SMU is a great choice for students looking for a world-class education in a vibrant city-state. Would you like more info on SMU's programs or admissions?

Bai Nian Yong Tau Foo at Albert Food Centre is one of my go-to comfort food stalls. I tried both the dry kuay and the soup bee hoon — the dry version comes with rice noodles in a tasty sauce, while the soup has a light, clean broth that feels so comforting. The Yong Tau Foo pieces taste fresh and handmade, especially the prawn paste and stuffed bitter gourd.

On top of that, their crispy chicken wings were juicy and well-marinated, and the golden wantons had the perfect crunch. Simple, hearty, and satisfying meal
The yong tau Foo is super delicious. And the prawn roll has to be one of the best I’ve ever eaten. Highly recommended! Be prepared to queue for a while.

The food was tasty and the broth full of flavour, it’s rich … yet comforting. I especially loved the chicken wings, which paired perfectly with the rest of the dishes. The portions were generous, and everything was served fresh and piping hot. The friendly service added to the experience. Definitely a place worth coming back to!

The place feels really comfortable and relaxing, and the coffee smells amazing and tastes very pure. The barista was also very friendly. After talking to them, I found out that their coffee beans are specially imported from Japan, and they have different flavor options to choose from.

I also really liked their cups~~every cup has a different design and looks super nice, which made the experience even more enjoyable.

Of course! I also tried their matcha. Since matcha is everywhere..but their matcha honestly surprised me because it tasted very different from the ones I’ve had before. It was smooth, lightly sweet, and very easy to drink, with no bitter or rough feeling at all.

Really recommend this café if you’re around!

Stumbled into this place accidentally, however loving it the first time stepping inside the cafe. Place is tiny but homey and aesthetic, surely will bring my niece here next time. The matcha omg so delicious, you can taste it’s not cheap one. Its coffee was also amazing. We ordered several drinks and nothing failed. The owner came and talked to us, very welcoming and gave information about the matcha and coffee. It’s a must visit if you ever strolling along haji lane.

Had a cold brew and iced matcha, and both were spot on for my picky taste. They use Brazilian beans, which is a big plus for me as I prefer coffee that's smooth, chocolatey, and not too acidic.

The place has a nice setup and decor, making it a comfortable spot to relax and enjoy a coffee. Price-wise, it's on the higher side & small cup, but that's pretty much expected considering it's located in a tourist area.

Overall, a good coffee stop if you appreciate quality beans and a pleasant atmosphere. Would definitely come back.

The food is sooo good! We ordered the fries with beef, chicken biryani, and the beef dish (I forgot what it's called). All the meat was tender and incredibly flavorful. I can honestly say it tastes authentic.

The drinks are really nice, not so sweet and the consistency is thick and milky (even the mango shake).

The service was great as well. The ambiance is nice, and the restaurant is air-conditioned, making it a comfortable place to dine. 🖤🖤

Every dish we ordered was tasty and full of flavour. I have to commend the warm hospitality shown by everyone there. It genuinely felt more like visiting a family friend’s home than dining at a restaurant.

The Kizhi Parotta was excellent, and the signature Kanthari Chicken Paal Curry was outstanding. The Nool Parotta was perfectly crispy, while the Kizhi Parotta was beautifully soaked in the curry, making every bite incredibly satisfying.

One thing I appreciated was that they informed us upfront, even before we ordered, that the food would take about 25 minutes to arrive. They delivered it right on time, which set expectations well and showed great professionalism.

The $1 cutting chai is absolutely worth trying. Served in authentic glass cups, it adds a nice touch to the overall vibe. It’s slightly on the sweeter side, but still very enjoyable.

Overall, this is an affordable restaurant serving high-quality food with genuinely warm and welcoming hospitality. A lovely family-run place that I can definitely see myself visiting often.

The food here is so, so yummy!! The Karak Chai was fragrant and went well with the flavourful egg coconut curry + fluffy crispt Porotta. I finished the meal with a Sulaimani 🌟 The mint leaf in the Sulaimani tasted fresh and the chef mentioned that it was from the small potted plant right outside the store!

Will definitely come back here again 💕 The menu is really extensive + informative, and the food tasted like it is made with kindness, thoughtfulness, and respect for the ingredients! The staff are all very attentive too. Really appreciate that they followed through with my "no corriander" and "less sugar" order.

The atmosphere here is really calm and chill, great for a meal with friends or just yourself 🌟

Thank you for the yummy meal!

Finally visited this spot I’ve had saved for ages, hidden inside Golden Mile Tower.

The place is small and cozy, and it also doubles as a vintage clothing and accessories shop, which makes it feel a little different from usual cafe. There are a few seats along the side where we can sit down and enjoy matcha.

I came on a weekday afternoon, but it was still pretty crowded. The wait was totally worth it though. I ordered the Banana Pudding Matcha, and it was super thick and creamy, basically like having dessert in a cup. It’s topped with cream, banana slices, lotus biscoff, and bits of cake, which made every sip extra indulgent and satisfying. No wonder this drink sells out so quickly!! I felt really lucky to catch it in time hehehehe

Such a cool little hidden gem overall. Definitely coming back to try their Strawberries Matcha next time!!!

Nice vibeee. Tried strawberry matcha (3.55 stars. Plain simple strawberry matcha nothing special) taro matcha (4 stars) taro flavour could be stronger ngl but still yum. Sea salt cold foam matcha (nice nice 4 stars) very delicious to lick the foam after haha. Overall 5 stars bc it’s a nice place to sit and talk with friends, very comfortable and aesthetically pleasing. It’s also in the same building as Filmhouse so great pre/post movie spot!

Came here after hearing so much about them. Got the strawberry matcha but honestly I was very disappointed. What surprised me even more was the lack of hygiene standards and professionalism the people of shift showed. As shown in the pictures attached below. Ice bucket not even covered, not sure when or if the chasen whisk have ever been rinsed regularly. What surprised me the most is that they pride themself on being a matcha house and charge pretty high prices but what I got and witness is pre made matcha and not freshly made. What is worst is the pre made matcha was not covered and left exposed??? Ice was even scooped with a plastic cup that was left in the ice bucket that was not even covered.

This is my go-to spot for an authentic Izakaya experience. I visit this place regularly.

Food:
SKEWERS (YAKITORI): The grilled skewers are exceptional. Each piece is perfectly seasoned. It is easily the highlight of the menu.

NOMIHODAI: The free-flow drink option is very well-priced and offers a great selection.

CUCUMBER DISH: A simple but must-order side dish. It is incredibly fresh and crisp.
